items.question: What form of Śrīdhara should be meditated upon in the heart to obtain human goals?
premises: Meditation is to be performed in the heart.
The object of meditation is Śrīdhara, the holder of Lakṣmī.
Śrīdhara is characterized as the giver of human goals.
items.inference: By meditating in the heart on Śrīdhara, who holds Lakṣmī and grants human goals, the practitioner aligns with the bestower of those aims.
uncertainties: The compound puruṣārthadam may be read as giving all four human goals or human aims generally.
items.plain_english: One should meditate in the heart on Śrīdhara, the holder of Lakṣmī, who grants the goals of human life.
